description: Current official Dutch OGC API source contract and bounded live verification for Amsterdam.
sourceScope: National Dutch cadastral map; only the bounded Amsterdam globe entry is enabled. Valid (G) records only. Boundaries are indicative and unsuitable for survey measurements or establishing legal title.

identity.note: Namespace and 14-digit local ID form the native cadastral identity. The upstream UUID is used only to detect repeated pages; numeric parcel numbers are display labels.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Kadaster / PDOK, Kadastrale Kaart, CC BY 4.0. Adapted to WGS84.

adapterContract.protocol: OGC API Features, GeoJSON, CQL2 text
adapterContract.crs: Explicit OGC CRS84 longitude/latitude for bbox and output
adapterContract.filter: status_historie_code = 'G'; namespace checked in returned properties because it is not a queryable field
adapterContract.paging: PDOK omits numberMatched. Completion requires validated links, no remaining next link, unique upstream feature IDs and bounded work. Any supplied match count must remain numeric and consistent.
adapterContract.nextLinks: Only the cursor from a same-origin, same-collection next link with unchanged query parameters is used; requests are rebuilt against the fixed endpoint.
